#### From HW9

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(tidymodels)

# Read from URL
bike_url <- "https://www4.stat.ncsu.edu/~online/datasets/SeoulBikeData.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv(bike_url, locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
```

```{r}
#Check missingness and structure
sum(is.na(raw_data))
glimpse(raw_data)

#Clean names, convert date format, convert factors
bike_clean <- raw_data |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  
  mutate(
    # Forma dataset dd/mm/yyyy
    date = dmy(date),
    seasons = as.factor(seasons),
    holiday = as.factor(holiday),
    functioning_day = as.factor(functioning_day)
  )

#Initial summaries =
bike_clean |>
  group_by(functioning_day) |>
  summarize(
    total_rentals = sum(rented_bike_count),
    mean_rentals = mean(rented_bike_count),
    n = n()
  )

# Filter to keep functional hours only:
bike_functional <- bike_clean |>
  filter(functioning_day == "Yes")

# 1 observation per day
# Sum for bike count, rainfall, snowfall, Mean for all other numeric weather variables
daily_bike <- bike_functional |>
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) |>
  summarize(
    rented_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count),
    rainfall = sum(rainfall_mm),
    snowfall = sum(snowfall_cm),
    temperature = mean(temperature_c),
    humidity = mean(humidity_percent),
    wind_speed = mean(wind_speed_m_s),
    visibility = mean(visibility_10m),
    dew_point_temperature = mean(dew_point_temperature_c),
    solar_radiation = mean(solar_radiation_mj_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Summaries
summary(daily_bike)

# Correlation matrix 
numeric_cols <- daily_bike |> select(where(is.numeric))
cor(numeric_cols)

# Exploratory plot: Rentals vs Temperature colored by Season
ggplot(daily_bike, aes(x = temperature, y = rented_bike_count, color = seasons)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Bike Rentals vs. Temperature by Season",
    x = "Mean Daily Temperature (°C)",
    y = "Total Daily Rentals"
  )
```

#### Splitting the data

```{r}


set.seed(123)

# 75/25 split by season
bike_split <- initial_split(daily_bike, prop = 0.75, strata = seasons)
train_data <- training(bike_split)
test_data  <- testing(bike_split)

# 10-fold CV split 
bike_folds <- vfold_cv(train_data, v = 10, strata = seasons)

```

#### Create MLR

```{r}
# 1st MLR
bike_rec1 <- recipe(rented_bike_count ~ ., data = train_data) |>
  update_role(date, new_role = "ID") |>
  step_date(date, features = "dow") |>
  step_mutate(
    day_type = factor(if_else(date_dow %in% c("Sat", "Sun"), "Weekend", "Weekday"))
  ) |>
  step_rm(date_dow) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(seasons, holiday, day_type)


```

#### Second MLR - First MLR + interaction

```{r}
# 2nd MLR, 1 + interactions
bike_rec2 <- bike_rec1 |>
  step_interact(
    terms = ~ starts_with("seasons_"):starts_with("holiday_") +
      starts_with("seasons_"):temperature +
      temperature:rainfall
  )

# 3rd MLR: MLR 2 + quadratic terms for temperature and humidity
bike_rec3 <- bike_rec2 |>
  step_mutate(temp_sq = temperature^2, hum_sq = humidity^2)

```

#### Fitting and evaluating MLR Models

```{r}

# Set up linear regression with "lm"
lm_spec <- linear_reg() |>
  set_engine("lm")

# combining each recipe with the linear mode
lm_wf1 <- workflow() |> add_recipe(bike_rec1) |> add_model(lm_spec)
lm_wf2 <- workflow() |> add_recipe(bike_rec2) |> add_model(lm_spec)
lm_wf3 <- workflow() |> add_recipe(bike_rec3) |> add_model(lm_spec)

# Evaluate all 3 across the 10 CV folds
cv_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, mae)

lm_res1 <- fit_resamples(lm_wf1, resamples = bike_folds, metrics = cv_metrics)
lm_res2 <- fit_resamples(lm_wf2, resamples = bike_folds, metrics = cv_metrics)
lm_res3 <- fit_resamples(lm_wf3, resamples = bike_folds, metrics = cv_metrics)

# Compare 10-fold CV results to pick the best model
mlr_cv_comparison <- bind_rows(
  collect_metrics(lm_res1) |> mutate(Model = "MLR 1 (Main Effects)"),
  collect_metrics(lm_res2) |> mutate(Model = "MLR 2 (+ Interactions)"),
  collect_metrics(lm_res3) |> mutate(Model = "MLR 3 (+ Quadratic)")
) |>
  filter(.metric == "rmse") |>
  select(Model, .metric, mean, std_err)

mlr_cv_comparison

```

#### Fitting the best model

```{r}
# Fit the best MLR modelto the entire training set and evaluate on test set
best_mlr_last_fit <- last_fit(lm_wf3, split = bike_split, metrics = cv_metrics)

# View test set RMSE and MAE
collect_metrics(best_mlr_last_fit)

```

#### Tuned Regression Tree

```{r}

library(rpart.plot)

set.seed(123)

#  Regression tree specification with tuning parameters
tree_spec <- decision_tree(
  cost_complexity = tune(),
  tree_depth = tune(),
  min_n = 20
) |>
  set_engine("rpart") |>
  set_mode("regression")

# using Recipe 1
tree_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(bike_rec1) |>
  add_model(tree_spec)

# Create tuning grid
tree_grid <- grid_regular(
  cost_complexity(),
  tree_depth(),
  levels = c(10, 5)
)

# Tune across the 10-fold CV folds
tree_res <- tune_grid(
  tree_wf,
  resamples = bike_folds,
  grid = tree_grid,
  metrics = cv_metrics
)

# Select best hyperparameters
best_tree_params <- select_best(tree_res, metric = "rmse")
best_tree_params

# Finalize and fit to entire training set
final_tree_wf <- finalize_workflow(tree_wf, best_tree_params)
tree_last_fit <- last_fit(final_tree_wf, split = bike_split, metrics = cv_metrics)

# Test set performance
collect_metrics(tree_last_fit)


# Extract the fitted rpart
tree_final_engine <- extract_fit_engine(tree_last_fit)

# Plot the fitted decision tree
rpart.plot(
  tree_final_engine, 
  roundint = FALSE, 
  type = 2, 
  extra = 101, 
  main = "Final Fitted Regression Tree"
)


```

####Tuned Bagged Tree

```{r}
library(baguette)

set.seed(123)

#Model specification with tuning parameters

bag_spec <- bag_tree(
  cost_complexity = tune(),
  tree_depth = 10,
  min_n = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("rpart", times = 50) |>
  set_mode("regression")

# Recipe 1
bag_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(bike_rec1) |>
  add_model(bag_spec)

# regular tuning grid
bag_grid <- grid_regular(
  cost_complexity(),
  min_n(),
  levels = 5
)

#Tune across the 10-fold CV folds
bag_res <- tune_grid(
  bag_wf,
  resamples = bike_folds,
  grid = bag_grid,
  metrics = cv_metrics
)


# Select best hyperparameters 
best_bag_params <- select_best(bag_res, metric = "rmse")
best_bag_params

# 6. Finalize workflow and fit to entire training set using last_fit()
final_bag_wf <- finalize_workflow(bag_wf, best_bag_params)
bag_last_fit <- last_fit(final_bag_wf, split = bike_split, metrics = cv_metrics)

# View test set metrics
collect_metrics(bag_last_fit)
```

#### Tuned Random Forest

```{r}
library(ranger)

set.seed(123)

# Random forest specification with tuning parameters
rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  mtry = tune(),
  trees = 500,
  min_n = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") |>
  set_mode("regression")

# Workflow using Recipe 1
rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(bike_rec1) |>
  add_model(rf_spec)

# Create regular tuning grid

rf_grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, 13)),
  min_n(range = c(2, 20)),
  levels = 5
)

#Tune across the 10-fold CV folds
rf_res <- tune_grid(
  rf_wf,
  resamples = bike_folds,
  grid = rf_grid,
  metrics = cv_metrics
)

#Select best hyperparameters based on RMSE
best_rf_params <- select_best(rf_res, metric = "rmse")
best_rf_params

#Finalize workflow and fit to entire training set using last_fit()
final_rf_wf <- finalize_workflow(rf_wf, best_rf_params)
rf_last_fit <- last_fit(final_rf_wf, split = bike_split, metrics = cv_metrics)

# View test set metrics
collect_metrics(rf_last_fit)
```

#### Compare Models on the Test Set

```{r}
# Combine test set metrics from each best family model
test_comparison <- bind_rows(
  collect_metrics(best_mlr_last_fit) |> mutate(Model = "MLR (Model 3)"),
  collect_metrics(tree_last_fit)     |> mutate(Model = "Regression Tree"),
  collect_metrics(bag_last_fit)      |> mutate(Model = "Bagged Tree"),
  collect_metrics(rf_last_fit)       |> mutate(Model = "Random Forest")
) |>
  select(Model, .metric, .estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate) |>
  arrange(rmse)

test_comparison
```

#### Model Summaries and Variable Importance Plots

```{r}
# MLR Final Coefficient Table
mlr_final_fit <- extract_fit_parsnip(best_mlr_last_fit)
tidy(mlr_final_fit)

# Bagged Tree Variable Importance 
bag_final_engine <- extract_fit_engine(bag_last_fit)

bag_final_engine$imp |>
  mutate(term = fct_reorder(term, value)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = term)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Variable Importance: Bagged Tree Model",
    x = "Importance Score",
    y = "Predictor"
  )

# Random Forest Variable Importance 
rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(rf_last_fit)

rf_importance <- tibble(
  Variable = names(rf_engine$variable.importance),
  Importance = rf_engine$variable.importance
)

ggplot(rf_importance, aes(x = Importance, y = fct_reorder(Variable, Importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Variable Importance: Random Forest Model",
    x = "Importance (Impurity)",
    y = "Predictor"
  )
```

#### Fit Overall Best Model to Entire Dataset

```{r}
# Identify the overall best model based on lowest test RMSE
best_model_name <- test_comparison$Model[1]
cat("Overall Best Model based on Test RMSE:", best_model_name, "\n")

# Match to the winning workflow and fit to the full daily_bike dataset
overall_best_wf <- switch(
  best_model_name,
  "MLR (Model 3)"   = lm_wf3,
  "Regression Tree" = final_tree_wf,
  "Bagged Tree"     = final_bag_wf,
  "Random Forest"   = final_rf_wf
)

final_full_fit <- fit(overall_best_wf, data = daily_bike)
final_full_fit
```
